failures.test: entrypoints publishes a statically-bound entrypoint for the current platform
failures.reason: Tests better-sqlite3's own file layout (lib/<platform>.js loading prebuilds/<platform>.node from the same package). potluckdb has the same entry points, but they load the binary from the @potluckdb/<platform> package; test/entrypoints.test.js covers them.

failures.test: entrypoints rejects nativeBinding from statically-bound entrypoints
failures.reason: Same as above: better-sqlite3's file layout. Covered by test/entrypoints.test.js.

failures.test: entrypoints keeps detection and compilation out of static entrypoint graphs
failures.reason: Same as above: better-sqlite3's file layout. Covered by test/entrypoints.test.js.

failures.test: Database#pragma() should execute the pragma, returning rows of results
failures.reason: Expects better-sqlite3's compiled-in page cache size (cache_size -16000, 16 MB). PotluckDB's library keeps SQLite's default (-2000, 2 MB), which only SQLite's build options can change.

failures.test: Database#pragma() should optionally return simpler results
verbose mode should not fully expand very long bound parameter
failures.reason: better-sqlite3 builds SQLite with SQLITE_TRACE_SIZE_LIMIT=32, which shortens long values in the SQL passed to the verbose logger. PotluckDB's library logs them in full.

failures.test: miscellaneous supports LIMIT in DELETE statements
failures.reason: DELETE ... LIMIT needs SQLite built with SQLITE_ENABLE_UPDATE_DELETE_LIMIT, which PotluckDB's library is not (yet).

failures.test: miscellaneous supports LIMIT in UPDATE statements
failures.reason: UPDATE ... LIMIT needs SQLite built with SQLITE_ENABLE_UPDATE_DELETE_LIMIT, which PotluckDB's library is not (yet).
